index.title: Where founders go deeper
index.summary: Practitioner-led programmes with the time and access to change how a business runs — taught by operators who have built at scale.
intro: Monthly masterclasses build the habit of learning. Our flagship programmes go further — immersive, high-access experiences designed to move a founder and their business a level up.
Alongside our own flagships, TiE Siliguri members can take part in TiE's global programmes for students and women entrepreneurs.

aiResidency.title: AI Immersion Residency
aiResidency.summary: A two-day residential immersion built to take founders from AI curiosity to AI capability — mindset, prompt engineering, workflow design and building your own AI edge.
overview: AI is moving faster than any single tool or course can keep up with. The Immersion Residency is designed differently: two focused days, away from the noise, that change how you think about AI in your business — not just which app you use.
You leave with a working grasp of how to put AI to work across your operations, and a first version of your own AI edge built during the programme.

items.title: The AI mindset
items.body: Reframing AI from a novelty to a leverage tool — where it changes the economics of your business and where it doesn't.

items.title: Prompt engineering
items.body: The practical craft of getting reliable, useful output from AI models, hands-on with real business tasks.

items.title: Workflow design
items.body: Mapping the repeatable work in your business and redesigning it around AI so time goes back to the work that matters.

items.title: Building your AI edge
items.body: Leaving with a first working version of an AI advantage specific to your own business.

forWho.body: Founders and business leaders who know AI matters but haven't yet made it part of how their business actually runs. No technical background required — the residency meets you where you are.

cta.title: Immersion places are limited and go to members first.
cta.label: Talk to us about a place

foundersImmersion.title: Founders' Immersion — Masters' Union
foundersImmersion.summary: An exclusive, practitioner-led programme for founders and family business owners, hosted inside an ecosystem of Fortune 500 companies at Masters' Union School of Business, Gurugram.
overview: For two days, TiE Siliguri members step out of their day-to-day and into one of India's most talked-about business schools — Masters' Union — to learn directly from operators, investors and founders who have built at scale.
It is a rare chance for North Bengal's founders to plug into a national network, benchmark their thinking against the best, and bring frameworks home that they can put to work immediately.

details.label: Where
details.value: Masters' Union School of Business, Gurugram

items.title: Practitioner sessions
items.body: Learning directly from founders and operators who have built and scaled real businesses.

items.title: Family business focus
items.body: Frameworks for the specific challenges of running and growing a family enterprise.

items.title: Fortune 500 ecosystem
items.body: Time inside an ecosystem built around Fortune 500 companies and India's fastest-moving startups.

items.title: National network
items.body: Connections with founders and mentors from across the wider TiE and Masters' Union networks.

forWho.body: Founders and family business owners ready to work on the business, not just in it — and to invest two days in the network and frameworks to do it.

cta.title: This immersion is open to TiE Siliguri members.
cta.label: Become a member

tye.title: TiE Young Entrepreneurs
tye.summary: TiE's global entrepreneurship programme for high-school students — experiential, mentor-led, and culminating in a global pitch competition. Coming to North Bengal.
overview: TiE Young Entrepreneurs (TYE) exists to start the next generation on the entrepreneurial pathway. It gives high-school students (grades 9–12) a real, hands-on experience of building a venture — from idea to pitch — guided by startup founders and industry experts.
We are working to bring TYE to Siliguri so that North Bengal's students can take part in a programme that has shaped young founders around the world.

items.title: Experiential curriculum
items.body: Students spend weekends across the programme learning the practical craft of turning an idea into a startup or small business.

items.title: Learn from founders
items.body: Sessions are led directly by startup founders and industry experts, not textbooks.

items.title: Team ventures
items.body: Students work in teams to build and shape a real business concept over the course of the programme.

items.title: Global pitch finals
items.body: The programme culminates in a global pitch competition — recent Global Finals have been held in Hyderabad, India and Silicon Valley, USA.

cta.label: Register your interest

tieWomen.title: TiE Women
tieWomen.summary: TiE's global platform dedicated to women entrepreneurs — mentoring, learning, networking and a global pitch stage. Coming to North Bengal.
overview: TiE Women is TiE Global's initiative to find, mentor and elevate women entrepreneurs everywhere. It combines learning and mentorship with a global pitch competition that puts women founders in front of investors and the wider TiE network.
TiE Siliguri intends to run TiE Women locally so that women founders across North Bengal can access this platform, its mentors and its stage.

items.title: Mentorship
items.body: Structured guidance from experienced founders and business leaders across the TiE network.

items.title: Learning
items.body: Practitioner-led sessions on the skills that decide whether a venture scales.

items.title: Global pitch competition
items.body: A stage to pitch to investors and mentors, from the local round through to the global finals.

items.title: Community
items.body: A network of women entrepreneurs supporting one another across chapters worldwide.
